name: How long does washing machine leak cleanup take?

mainEntity.name: How long does washing machine leak cleanup take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a washing machine leak cleanup depends on the severity of the leak and the affected area. For minor surface leaks, cleanup might take a few hours. For significant water damage involving saturated subflooring or walls, the water extraction and drying process can take 3-5 days. Mold remediation, if necessary, could extend the timeline further. Our goal is to dry the affected area completely to prevent secondary issues like mold.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup time ranges from a few hours for minor leaks to 3-5 days for significant water damage requiring professional drying.
